Internal: jsum()'s and javg()'s one worker

Source: R/scales.R
dot-jst_row_score.Rd

jsum() and javg() were one body twice over (Session 386, the twin build): the first argument resolved, the variables read, the declared missing values masked, each case's sum or mean computed against min.valid, the summary line, the assign-or-lose reminder and the label. The captures – the data argument as typed, whether it was given, the variables in ..., the calling frame – are made in the function the user called and passed here; data_sub is read only where jsum() read it, since it is R's missing-argument marker when the data were left out under a juse() default (S371).

Usage

.jst_row_score(
  what,
  fn,
  data_sub,
  data_missing,
  quos_list,
  envir,
  min.valid,
  fixed,
  var.label,
  example,
  call,
  fun
)

Arguments

what

"sum" or "mean".

fn

Character(1): "jsum" or "javg".

data_sub

The data argument's expression (substitute(data)).

data_missing

Logical(1): missing(data) in the caller.

quos_list

The variables (rlang::enquos(...) in the caller).

envir

The caller's calling frame.

min.valid, var.label

The call's arguments.

fixed

Logical(1): javg()'s fixed denominator (FALSE for jsum()).

example

Character(1): the example line of the two-variables stop.

call, fun

sys.call() and sys.function() of the caller, for the resolver's rebuilt lines.

Value

The new variable, invisibly.
